items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Debussy went to the academy, but he didn’t graduate either. I understand that.

ctx.x: And Debussy went to the academy, but he didn’t graduate either. I understand that.

So consequently, the open-ended situation – when I say open-ended, there was a young lady that I heard – I didn’t get to know her that well – went to Virginia Commonwealth. By the time I got to Virginia Commonwealth, she was doing a senior recital. She was a vocalist. I think that was her main thing, but I don’t know. Anyway, she had to sing the usual three languages, Italian, French, German. She had also been studying in the jazz studies division with the band teacher, arranging. She arranged two or three pieces…
